licenceReview.notes: The WFO download page identifies the static Taxonomic Backbone data as CC0 1.0 Universal. Only the taxonomy backbone fields selected by this adapter are imported. The Zenodo archive publishes an MD5 and byte size; the reconciliation run additionally records a SHA-256 of the exact local archive.
